reddit.title: 5 things I would check before buying a wireless CarPlay adapter
reddit.body: The cheap-versus-expensive comparison is not the first thing I would look at. I would confirm that wired CarPlay already works reliably, that the USB port carries data, that there is evidence about cold-start reconnection, that firmware can be updated, and that the return route is practical. I put the checklist in one place here: https://trendpilotchoice.com/products/wireless-carplay-adapters/

quora.question: Will a wireless CarPlay adapter work in my car?
quora.answer: For the common wired-to-wireless type, start by confirming that the car already supports reliable wired Apple CarPlay. Then check whether the USB port carries data, whether the adapter has a clear firmware-update method, what users report about reconnection after the car has been parked, and whether the return terms are practical. TrendPilot has a short five-point checklist: https://trendpilotchoice.com/products/wireless-carplay-adapters/
